meta.name: description
meta.content: PickleballTV: live pickleball 24/7, free. PPA Tour and Major League Pickleball, plus original shows and podcasts.
meta.title: PickleballTV

div.p: The only channel that never leaves the court. PPA Tour and Major League Pickleball live, plus original shows, podcasts and the kitchen talk in between. No sign-up required to start watching.
Also on Prime Video, The Roku Channel, Samsung TV Plus and more. All times Eastern.

div.span: Live events can run long. When they do, the following program joins in progress.

div.p: PickleballTV is available to stream on
Watch PickleballTV on these streaming services. Some are free and some need a subscription. Please check back for new launches on other TV platforms.

ul.li: The 24/7 live channel, no account needed
PPA Tour and MLP as they air
Original shows in the linear lineup
Every court from every event, live and on demand
Full match replays and condensed matches
Originals and podcasts whenever you want them

div.span: Current pricing and plan names are shown at checkout.

div.p: Tournament updates, behind-the-scenes, plus tips and tricks from the pros.
A Tennis Channel network. Pickleball, wherever and whenever you want it.
